Subject: Mutual Action Plan: owners & dates + quick follow-up

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have the MAP aligned in one place:

Summary of scope
- 2-week eval of Redwood Dedicated (1 GPU pool) to validate latency and cost for RLHF-inference workloads.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 150ms at target throughput; <20% delta in output quality vs. baseline.

Mutual Action Plan (attached: NimbleHealth_MAP_v1.2.pdf) — please confirm owners and dates for each row:
- Technical lead (integration & test): proposed owner: Sara Brown — proposed start: 2026-03-15
- Platform owner (networking/KMS): we need a named contact for the VPC setup — suggested by Nimble: procurement loop?
- Evaluation lead (quality): Redwood SE (Rishi) to run eval harness — proposed window: 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-30

Action items for you
1) Confirm who from NimbleHealth will own the platform/VPC setup and procurement point-of-contact (email).
2) Are the proposed start dates (Mar 15 / Mar 16) realistic, or should we shift by one or two weeks?
3) Confirm whether you'd like us to provision an isolated test pool (Dedicated) or start on Hosted with a plan to migrate.

I've attached a short evaluation checklist (Redwood_Eval_Checklist.xlsx) to make the test acceptance criteria explicit. If you prefer, we can do a 15-minute sync Thurs to lock owners —open slots: 2026-03-04 10:00-10:30 or 2026-03-05 14:00-14:30 PT.

If I don't hear back on owners/dates by end of week I'll follow up, but wanted to get this in your inbox so procurement and your engineers can plan.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0124
